page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 154 at top left. Two parallel columns of verse (hymn stanzas) in the upper block, each with a heading below; then a heading and a prayer paragraph; then a heading and two parallel columns of hymn verse. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: BENEDICTIO, MANE ET sere dicenda.
main_text.p: Pax Domini nostri Jesu Christi, & virtus passionis ejus, lignū † sanctæ crucis, integritas beatæ Mariæ virginis, Benedictio omnium Sanctorū, Angelorum custodia, & suffragia omnium Dei electorum, sint inter me & omnes inimicos meos, visibiles & invisibiles, nunc & semper, & in hora mortis, &c.
main_text.head: AD NOCTURNUM Hymnus.

page.notes: Lower-right stanza edges and some words in the hymn columns are faint; "Supplicitor" and "Confessoresque" in the right column are uncertain. The line "Divi-" is a catchword-like fragment at the foot and was read as text. Running head text was read as printed in the top band.
